name: MonarchTemplatePicker
title: TemplatePicker
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.grid.LazyVerticalGrid with GridCells.Adaptive of selectable androidx.compose.material3.Surface cards and androidx.compose.material3.RadioButton marks in a selectableGroup; MonarchTag filters, MonarchSearchBar and MonarchEmptyState
summary: A gallery of templates to start from, with category filters, search and an optional "start from scratch" card first.
whenToUse: When creating a document, project or board can start from one of many ready-made templates, usually on its own screen or in a full-height sheet.
whenNotToUse: For a handful of options with no previews or search, use MonarchRadioCardGroup. For AI prompt templates, use the AI prompt template picker when it exists.
api: @Composable fun MonarchTemplatePicker(label: String, templates: List<MonarchTemplatePickerItem>, selected: String?, onSelect: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, categories: List<MonarchTemplatePickerCategory> = emptyList(), initialCategory: String? = null, query: String = "", onQueryChange: ((String) -> Unit)? = null, blank: MonarchTemplatePickerBlank? = null, enabled: Boolean = true, state: LazyGridState = rememberLazyGridState(), labels: MonarchTemplatePickerLabels = MonarchTemplatePickerLabels())

class MonarchTemplatePickerItem(id: String, name: String, description: String? = null, category: String? = null, badge: String? = null, keywords: List<String> = emptyList(), enabled: Boolean = true, preview: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchTemplatePickerBlank(id: String = "blank", name: String? = null, description: String? = null, preview: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

class MonarchTemplatePickerLabels(categories: String? = null, allCategories: String? = null, blank: String? = null, search: String? = null, results: ((Int) -> String)? = null, noResults: ((String) -> String)? = null, emptyCategory: String? = null)

options.name: label
options.description: The name of the gallery, read by TalkBack. It is not shown; the screen's title usually says it.

options.name: templates
options.description: The templates in order, each with a name and an optional description, category, badge, keywords, preview slot and enabled flag.

options.name: selected
options.description: The id of the chosen template or of the blank card, or null for none yet.

options.name: onSelect
options.description: Called with the id the person chose.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the gallery. Give it a bounded height: the grid scrolls on its own.

options.name: categories
options.description: Category filters, shown as a scrolling row of MonarchTag toggles with "All" first when given.

options.name: initialCategory
options.description: The category filter selected at first. All by default.

options.name: query
options.description: The search text. Every word must appear in the name, description or keywords.

options.name: onQueryChange
options.description: Shows a MonarchSearchBar at the top and is called as the person types. Leave it null when the screen has its own search field and passes query.

options.name: blank
options.description: A "start from scratch" card shown first whatever the filters; its name defaults to "Blank".

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether any card or filter can be used.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the grid.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the filter names, the blank name, the search placeholder, the announced count and the empty messages.

states.name: selected
states.description: The chosen card has the accent subtle fill, a heavier accent strong border and a filled radio mark.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The Material 3 surface shows its press ripple.

states.name: disabled template
states.description: Subtle fill with disabled text and an empty disabled mark; it cannot be chosen.

states.name: no results
states.description: A filtered MonarchEmptyState saying no templates match the search, with Clear filters, under the blank card.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With enabled false every card, filter and the search field are disabled.

appearance: Cards use the surface color with a default border and 12dp corners; the chosen card the accent subtle fill and a 2dp accent strong border, the same colors as MonarchRadioCardGroup. Previews sit on the subtle background with 8dp corners. Names use the strong body style, descriptions the caption style in the muted color. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: Like the web, the picker can show its own search field (MonarchSearchBar, when onQueryChange is given); like iOS, it can instead take the query from the screen's own search field. The category filter is kept by the picker (saved across configuration changes) and starts from initialCategory, as the web's defaultCategory; the selection is hoisted. The web's renderPreview pane is not offered: on a phone the app shows a preview after the choice, for example in the next step. Previews are a composable slot rather than free content. The web's arrow-key grid navigation is replaced by TalkBack and the system's directional focus moving through the cards. The parity map lists radio-card-group: the cards reuse its colors and radio mark, but are laid out in a lazy adaptive grid with previews and badges, which MonarchRadioCardGroup does not offer. When nothing matches, Clear filters resets the category and, when the picker owns the search field, the search.
accessibility: The grid is a traversal group named by label, and a selectable group.
Each card is one element with the radio button role, the selected state, the name, the badge and the description, and is at least 48dp high.
Selection is also shown by the radio mark and a heavier border, not by color alone.
Category filters are MonarchTag toggles in a group named "Categories".
When the category or the search changes, the number of templates shown is announced through a polite live region.
Cards are at least 144dp wide times the font scale, so the largest font size shows one column.
edgeCases: The blank card is never hidden by the filters.
Search ignores case and accents and matches the words in any order.
A selected template hidden by a filter stays selected.
A category with no templates says "No templates in this category."
Template ids are list keys, so they must be unique and differ from the blank card's id.
